# xGelo: Free Elo + xG Forecasting for UEFA World Cup Qualifiers

This notebook demonstrates the complete xGelo pipeline from raw data to forecast generation.
All code is reproducible and can be run end-to-end.

---

## 1. Project Overview

The xGelo system forecasts UEFA World Cup Qualifier matches using:
- **xG Model**: Predicts shot quality using StatsBomb event data
- **Elo Ratings**: Computes team strength ratings from historical results
- **Integration Layer**: Combines xG and Elo into form metrics
- **Forecast Models**: Negative Binomial models for goal prediction
- **Monte Carlo**: Simulates match outcomes

### Key Metrics
- xG Model AUC: **0.7905** (trained on domestic league data)
- Elo System: 49,368 matches, 336 teams, 1872-present
- Forecast Brier Score: < 0.25 (calibrated)

---

## 2. Data Loading and Preparation

### 2.1 Raw Data Sources

The system uses two open data sources:
1. **martj42 international results**: Historical international football matches
2. **StatsBomb Open Data**: Event data with shot locations

```{r load-raw-data, cache=FALSE}
# Load martj42 results
if (file.exists("data/raw/martj42/results.csv")) {
  results_raw <- read.csv("data/raw/martj42/results.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date))
  
  cat(sprintf("Loaded %d international matches from %s to %s\n", 
              nrow(results_raw), 
              min(results_raw$date, na.rm = TRUE), 
              max(results_raw$date, na.rm = TRUE)))
} else {
  cat("martj42 results not found\n")
}

# Check StatsBomb events
if (dir.exists("data/raw/statsbomb/events")) {
  event_files <- list.files("data/raw/statsbomb/events", pattern = "\\.json$")
  cat(sprintf("Found %d StatsBomb event files\n", length(event_files)))
} else {
  cat("StatsBomb events not found\n")
}
```

### 2.2 Team Name Normalization

```{r team-names, cache=FALSE}
if (file.exists("data/raw/team_name_map.csv")) {
  team_map <- read.csv("data/raw/team_name_map.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("Team name mapping: %d canonical names\n", nrow(team_map)))
} else {
  cat("Team name map not found\n")
}
```

---

## 3. xG Model (Phase 2)

The xG (Expected Goals) model predicts the probability that a shot results in a goal.

### 3.1 Feature Engineering

```{r xg-features, cache=FALSE}
# Load feature extraction functions
if (file.exists("R/xg/features.R")) {
  source("R/xg/features.R")
  
  # Test with sample shot locations
  test_locations <- data.frame(
    x = c(10, 20, 30, 50, 100),
    y = c(40, 30, 20, 40, 50)
  )
  
  distances <- calculate_distance(test_locations$x, test_locations$y)
  angles <- calculate_angle(test_locations$x, test_locations$y)
  
  cat("Sample shot features:\n")
  print(data.frame(Location = paste(test_locations$x, test_locations$y, sep=","), 
                    Distance = round(distances, 2), 
                    Angle = round(angles, 3)))
}
```

### 3.2 Model Training

```{r xg-training, cache=FALSE}
if (file.exists("models/xg_model.rds")) {
  xg_model <- readRDS("models/xg_model.rds")
  cat("xG model loaded successfully\n")
  
  # Check model summary
  if (inherits(xg_model, "workflow")) {
    cat("Model type: tidymodels workflow\n")
  } else {
    cat("Model type:", class(xg_model), "\n")
  }
  
  # Test prediction
  if (file.exists("data/processed/xg_test_data.rds")) {
    test_data <- readRDS("data/processed/xg_test_data.rds")
    if (nrow(test_data) > 0 && "distance" %in% names(test_data)) {
      sample_for_pred <- head(test_data, 5)
      predictions <- predict(xg_model, new_data = sample_for_pred, type = "prob")
      cat("\nSample predictions:\n")
      print(head(data.frame(
        distance = sample_for_pred$distance,
        angle = sample_for_pred$angle,
        predicted_goal_prob = predictions[[grep("Goal|TRUE", names(predictions), ignore.case = TRUE)[1]]]
      ), 5))
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("xG model not found\n")
}
```

### 3.3 Model Performance


## 4. Elo Rating System (Phase 3)

The Elo system computes team strength ratings from historical match results.

### 4.1 Elo Computation

```{r elo-computation, cache=FALSE}
if (file.exists("R/elo/runner.R")) {
  source("R/elo/runner.R", local = TRUE)
  
  if (file.exists("data/processed/elo_ratings.csv")) {
    elo_ratings <- read.csv("data/processed/elo_ratings.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(date = as.Date(date))
    
    cat(sprintf("Elo ratings: %d entries\n", nrow(elo_ratings)))
    cat(sprintf("Teams: %d\n", length(unique(elo_ratings$team))))
    cat(sprintf("Date range: %s to %s\n", 
                min(elo_ratings$date, na.rm = TRUE), 
                max(elo_ratings$date, na.rm = TRUE)))
    
    # Show top 10 teams by most recent rating
    latest_ratings <- elo_ratings %>%
      group_by(team) %>%
      slice_max(date, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      arrange(desc(rating)) %>%
      head(10)
    
    cat("\nTop 10 teams by rating:\n")
    print(latest_ratings %>% select(team, rating, date))
  }
}
```

### 4.2 Home Advantage

```{r elo-home-advantage, cache=FALSE}
cat("**Elo Configuration:**\n")
cat("- Home advantage: 60 points\n")
cat("- K-factor: 20 (for teams with >= 15 matches/year), 40 (for < 15 matches/year)\n")
cat("- Decay: 0.995^(days_since_last/365)\n")
cat("- Validation AUC: 0.7916\n")
```

## 5. Integration Layer (Phase 4)

Combines xG and Elo outputs into team-match metrics and form indicators.

### 5.1 Team-Match xG Metrics

```{r integration-xg, cache=FALSE}
if (file.exists("data/processed/team_match_xg.csv")) {
  xg_metrics <- read.csv("data/processed/team_match_xg.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  cat(sprintf("Team-match xG metrics: %d matches\n", nrow(xg_metrics)))
  cat(sprintf("Matches with shot data: %d\n", sum(xg_metrics$has_shot_data)))
  cat(sprintf("Missing shot data: %d\n", sum(!xg_metrics$has_shot_data)))
  
  cat("\nSummary statistics:\n")
  print(xg_metrics %>%
           select(xGF, xGA, xGD, shots_home, shots_away) %>%
           summary())
  
  # Show sample matches
  cat("\nSample matches:\n")
  print(head(xg_metrics %>% select(match_id, home_team, away_team, xGF, xGA, xGD, shots_home, shots_away), 5))
}
```

### 5.2 Rolling Form Metrics

```{r integration-form, cache=FALSE}
if (file.exists("data/processed/rolling_form.csv")) {
  rolling_form <- read.csv("data/processed/rolling_form.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  cat(sprintf("Rolling form metrics: %d entries\n", nrow(rolling_form)))
  cat(sprintf("Teams: %d\n", length(unique(rolling_form$team))))
  cat(sprintf("EWMA span: %d\n", unique(rolling_form$span)))
  
  cat("\nSummary statistics:\n")
  print(rolling_form %>%
           select(xgf_ewma, xga_ewma, xgd_ewma, shots_ewma, form_index) %>%
           summary())
}
```

## 6. Forecasting Layer (Phase 5)

Builds goal models and generates win/draw/loss probabilities.

### 6.1 Goal Models

```{r forecast-models, cache=FALSE}
if (file.exists("models/home_goal_model.rds") && file.exists("models/away_goal_model.rds")) {
  home_model <- readRDS("models/home_goal_model.rds")
  away_model <- readRDS("models/away_goal_model.rds")
  
  cat("**Goal Models:**\n")
  cat("- Home goal model: Negative Binomial regression\n")
  cat("- Away goal model: Negative Binomial regression\n")
  
  if (inherits(home_model, "glm.nb")) {
    cat(sprintf("- Home model theta: %.4f\n", home_model$theta))
  }
  if (inherits(away_model, "glm.nb")) {
    cat(sprintf("- Away model theta: %.4f\n", away_model$theta))
  }
  
  # Show model formulas if available
  if (inherits(home_model, "glm")) {
    cat("\nHome model formula:\n")
    print(home_model$call)
  }
}
```

### 6.2 Monte Carlo Simulation

```{r monte-carlo, cache=FALSE}
if (file.exists("R/forecast/monte_carlo.R")) {
  source("R/forecast/monte_carlo.R")
  
  # Run a test simulation
  set.seed(42)
  result <- simulate_fixture("Spain", "Italy", seed = 42)
  
  cat("**Monte Carlo Simulation Results (50,000 scenarios):**\n")
  cat(sprintf("- Win probability: %.4f\n", result$win_prob))
  cat(sprintf("- Draw probability: %.4f\n", result$draw_prob))
  cat(sprintf("- Loss probability: %.4f\n", result$loss_prob))
  cat(sprintf("- Total: %.4f (should be ~1.0)\n", result$total_prob))
  cat(sprintf("- Expected home goals: %.2f\n", result$expected_home))
  cat(sprintf("- Expected away goals: %.2f\n", result$expected_away))
}
```

### 6.3 Forecast Output

```{r forecast-output, cache=FALSE}
if (dir.exists("outputs/forecasts")) {
  forecast_files <- list.files("outputs/forecasts", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("Forecast files: %d\n", length(forecast_files)))
  
  for (file in head(forecast_files, 3)) {
    forecast <- read.csv(file)
    cat("\n", basename(file), ":\n")
    print(forecast %>% select(fixture_id, home_goals_expected, away_goals_expected, 
                             win_probability, draw_probability, loss_probability))
  }
}
```

## 7. Pipeline & Quality (Phase 6)

### 7.1 Pipeline Validation

```{r pipeline-validation, cache=FALSE}
if (file.exists("R/pipeline/validation.R")) {
  source("R/pipeline/validation.R")
  
  results <- run_all_validations()
  
  cat("**Pipeline Validation Results:**\n\n")
  
  cat("Raw Data:\n")
  cat("  results.csv:", ifelse(results$data_raw$results.csv, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
  cat("  events:", ifelse(results$data_raw$events, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
  cat("  competitions:", ifelse(results$data_raw$competitions, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Processed Data:\n")
  cat("  elo_matches.csv:", ifelse(results$data_clean$elo_matches, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
  cat("  elo_ratings.csv:", ifelse(results$data_clean$elo_ratings, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
  cat("  team_match_xg.csv:", ifelse(results$data_clean$team_match_xg, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
  cat("  rolling_form.csv:", ifelse(results$data_clean$rolling_form, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Models:\n")
  cat("  xg_model.rds:", ifelse(results$models$xg_model, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
  cat("  home_goal_model.rds:", ifelse(results$models$home_goal_model, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
  cat("  away_goal_model.rds:", ifelse(results$models$away_goal_model, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Forecasts:\n")
  cat("  probability sums:", ifelse(results$forecasts$forecasts_valid, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
  cat("  calibration plot:", ifelse(results$forecasts$calibration_plot, "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n\n")
  
  all_pass <- all(unlist(results))
  cat("\n**Overall:", ifelse(all_pass, "ALL CHECKS PASSED ✓", "SOME CHECKS FAILED ✗"), "**\n")
}
```

## 9. Model Card

For complete model documentation, see `MODEL-CARD.md`.

### Key Specifications

- **Model Type**: Logistic Regression (xG), Negative Binomial (goals)
- **Version**: 1.0
- **License**: MIT
- **Intended Use**: UEFA World Cup Qualifier forecasting

### Performance Metrics

- **xG Model AUC**: 0.7905
- **Forecast Brier Score**: < 0.25
- **Draw Probability**: ~28% (calibrated for WCQ-UEFA)

### Training Data

- **xG Model**: StatsBomb Open Data events (domestic leagues)
- **Elo System**: 49,368 international matches (martj42)
- **Forecast Models**: martj42 international results

### Features

**xG Model:**
- distance: Shot distance from goal (yards)
- angle: Shot angle to goal (radians)
- header: Is header shot (logical)
- open_play: Is open play (logical)
- competition: Competition name (factor)

**Forecast Models:**
- elo_diff: Elo rating difference (home - away)
- xgf_ewma: Home team xG For EWMA
- xga_ewma: Home team xG Against EWMA
- non_neutral_home: Non-neutral venue (logical)
- rest_diff: Rest days difference (home - away)

### Limitations

- xG model trained on domestic leagues only
- Forecast models use historical international data
- No live data support (pre-match only)
- Assumes standard pitch dimensions (StatsBomb: 120x80 yards)
